definition.name: POSM & Promotional Materials · internal candidate v1
definition.description: UNAPPROVED CANDIDATE · INTERNAL EVIDENCE PILOT. Human evidence capture only; not an official GTI standard. No conditional rules, skip, external dispatch, procurement, automatic tasks or archive. After all stages, project closure still requires a separately Director-approved per-project document policy, actual Owner completion request and separate Director final decision. Blueprint gti-posm-promotional-materials revision 1; source 2026-09-29 SHA-256 4d86f90d173a406ad9f3a5ffbba7ce55776b5d209f4bc2a0e4653f299d61b944. Material Type is visible but does not change gates. Printed and merchandise fields are optional; all six evidence stages remain fixed. No three-offer count, per-outlet photo minimum, stock reconciliation or signed acceptance enforcement. Internal candidate choice: requiredness, bounds, file counts, reviewer routing and fixed gates need business confirmation.

workflow.interpretation: Source sequence retained as configurable evidence stages. Creative work uses existing Universal Tasks; no legacy concept engine. Internal candidate choice: requiredness, bounds, file counts, reviewer routing and fixed gates need business confirmation.

gaps.missing: Field requiredness, detailed checklists, reviewer identities where unspecified, file limits and fixed pilot gates are proposed; no approved official designation process.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Every field and block labels candidate choices. Owner brief review is a proposed internal route, not a source-assigned approver.

gaps.missing: Material Type cannot change field/checklist requirements, make sourcing conditionally mandatory or allow Director-approved printed research skipping.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: One template, visible Printed POSM / Merchandise selector, optional branch fields and fixed stages for both. Human applicability review; no skip or bypass.

gaps.missing: No structured vendor comparison or enforcement of at least three distinct RFP offers, per-offer MOQ, lead time, price and sample availability.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Optional merchandise quote files and scalar summaries record evidence only; file count never substitutes for distinct offers.

gaps.missing: No CERBER verification, Director external vendor selection, procurement, agreed external order conditions or approved production-order dispatch.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Record references and independent Director internal evidence review. No vendor message, order or payment is sent.

gaps.missing: No concept-to-stage task gate, all-format adaptation validation or enforcement of merchandise 1–2 revision rounds.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Manually create Initial/Final Concept Universal Tasks. Review exact uploaded design evidence; task references and round summaries do not prove task completion.

gaps.missing: No repeating format, apparel-size, quantity or outlet-distribution records or cross-row completeness checks.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Optional branch summaries and attached registers; no paragraph is treated as a validated row matrix.

gaps.missing: No per-outlet photo count calculated against the minimum in the brief.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Record the brief minimum as an optional Printed POSM number and attach photos/report. Fixed file limits do not enforce that number.

gaps.missing: No physical golden-sample lifecycle, proof authenticity, mass-production or batch-quality certification.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Human review of submitted proof/sample/QC evidence only, retaining reviewer independence.

gaps.missing: No real stock, warehouse intake, department/event issue or delivery/distribution quantity reconciliation.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Store records and review notes without asserting inventory state.

gaps.missing: No local advertising compliance engine, binary artwork preflight or print/merchandise variant validation.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Capture supplied restrictions, exact files and human File Standard attestations; no legal certification.

gaps.missing: No prefilled Creative Brief/RFP, signed external contracts, bilateral Acceptance Protocol, external document lifecycle or lawyer-approved wording. Fixed document stage numbers conflict with POSM's six stages.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Upload manually prepared documents by business purpose. Optional framework/copyright evidence is not a signature or pre-production legal gate; final document policy stays separate.

gaps.missing: No automatic scheduling, budget accounting or template starter-task generation; source durations/tasks remain open.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Store agreed dates, currency and budget values; create actual General Tasks manually.

gaps.missing: Source completion/automatic archive cannot substitute for V2 explicit final-project governance or establish signed acceptance.
gaps.internalPilotTreatment: Stage evidence gates only. Explicit Director document policy, actual Owner request and separate Director final decision; no automatic archive.

tasker.instructions: Manually create Initial Concept tasks for Key Visual / directions and format adaptations. Existing independent review applies; no new fixed concept stage or minimum task count.

Manually create Final Concept tasks using eligible exact inspiration where appropriate; retain merchandise logo/colour revisions. Source 1–2 rounds and all-format coverage are not automatically enforced.

blueprint.revisionPolicy: Increment blueprint revision for content or policy changes. Keep semantic IDs for unchanged meanings; new meanings need new IDs and a compatibility map. Imported copies are editable and edits are not automatically source-certified. Published versions and runtime pins never change.
